coverage.reason: Approved HUD image buttons retain original targets and positions, existing event handlers and dynamic saved heraldry. Draft comparison tests cover exact geometry, decoded alpha artwork, badges and no network writes; startup readiness is null-safe during navigation. Production art tests verify the compressed approved sources/hashes, actual navigation, mouse/touch/keyboard, Profile dirty-exit guards, clan shield clearance, no-clan state, map zoom independence and affected shared HUD controls. Production screen-edge/fullscreen and Crowns HUD tests cover shared profile layout, currency and stamina bounds at desktop and landscape sizes. Existing production artifact and asset-budget gates check runtime image delivery, offline stylesheet linkage and source-master exclusion. README/provenance and the Master Specification record the owner-approved design. No server-authoritative source, database or gameplay rule changes, so no emulator suites are needed. The measured 1,771-byte offline-shell increase is bounded at 2 KiB and the 67,824-byte runtime images at 68 KiB; per-image and login preload caps remain unchanged.
